meta.model: L3 = twin gate errors + T1/T2 on every idle window (own scheduler) + feed-forward latency + asymmetric readout + measure_2 readout (B); L3+ = L3 + random detuning (sigma 3 kHz), static ZZ (calibrated |11> phase), sx over-rotation (sigma 0.3 %); drift = twins of past calibrations

per_circuit.rule: flag if TVD(measured, predicted) > shot-noise 99.9 % quantile + max(0.05, band)
